scope: the 31 questions still missed by the current system on the 300cn set
method: For each gold keyword, count chunks/occurrences over the official blob (text + chapter_title + scene_title + part_title); for keywords with <=5 chunks, print and judge ~110 chars of surrounding context. Verdicts hand-judged from that context.
policy: 只读审计：不修改 rag_testset_300_cn.json 或任何既有题集；本文件为唯一新增侧车文件。

summary.note: 有效题中的英文 gold（Charlotte/Tooth Fairy/Doris/Ulrich/Zero/…）几乎全部 0 命中——语料为纯中文，英文原名不存在；这类 0 命中关键词是噪声而非独立缺陷，只要同题存在有效中文锚点即仍判有效。
